description: A longer candidate counts only if the constituent's test holds of it. y⊇~p before [T] reads y → A with the tag p. The longer y → A B has the tag q, so the test fails of it, the omission is permitted, and begins of r holds (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A B
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y⊇~p [++T] B
%rule y A <~p> | A B <~q>
